notes: «ح» joins two families that meet at شعبة; the text writes عمرو بن مرة, سعيد بن المسيب, معاوية once, after the second family's شعبة, so they are the shared tail (rule 3).
Mu'awiya's words ("ما كنت أرى أن أحدا يفعله") are the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6). «- وابن، بشار -» stray comma kept in the surface as written.
